source_title: Patrick Stewart's extraordinary career from British theatre to Hollywood – video obituary
source_excerpt:
Patrick Stewart was both a staple of the British stage and a global star known for his role in Star Trek and X-Men. As Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation, Stewart reached millions worldwide.
The Guardian associate film editor Andrew Pulver reflects on his career and legacy, from stage to sci-fi
